find_triplet_sum: find a triplet in an array that sums to a given target value using brute force
run_f_gold: run f_gold to check if any three elements in an array add up to a specified sum
test_triplet_search: test the triplet sum search function against multiple input arrays and expected target sums
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to use a two-pointer approach instead of the O(n cubed) nested loop solution
summarize_f_gold: summarize the f_gold function that finds three numbers in an array summing to a target value
